name: Wilderness bears
accessNote: Grizzly bears spawn in the low-level Wilderness west of the Graveyard of Shadows (about 10 spawns) and near the Dark Warriors' Fortress, plus north-west of the Ferox Enclave. Required for Krystilia's Wilderness bears task; bring only risk-appropriate gear as PKers frequent the area. Multicombat, cannon, and safespot status are not documented on the wiki and are left conservative (false).
